note: Heard County GA publishes its tax parcel polygons as ArcGIS Online feature service HeardCountyParcels (org shlUlNKW81IHLNtJ), but every layer on that org, including the parcel layer and Heard_County_Boundary, returns 'Token Required' on probe. The parcel data is behind a login/token, so it is not openly queryable. Other sources found are commercial (Dynamo Spatial, Rockford Map, Regrid) or the Schneider qPublic viewer, which is Cloudflare-blocked and not a documented public REST service. No public Heard County parcel service or file was found.
